RC1 · A REVIEW COPY FOR A DEVELOPER

Dear reader, would you read two chapters?

From the editor of The ultimate insider, a book about one day in which one person and a team of AI agents built a talk, with the record to prove it.

Why you
You build with agents every day. If a control here hides work, or a number cannot be rerun from the record, you are the reader who will try it and find out.
What we would like
Two chapters, about 26 minutes, by Friday 13 November 2026 (an example date: nothing has been sent), and your answers to a few questions at the end of each.
What you get back
your name in the acknowledgements, if you want it there
the first edition when it ships
a reply to every comment, and a page showing what your comments changed
